paper_title: Vector Wave Dark Matter and Terrestrial Quantum Sensors
notes: Paper derives theoretical projected sensitivities for detecting ultralight B-L vector dark matter using optomechanical cavity sensors. Section 3.2 (titled 'Projected Exclusions') and Section 4 present Monte Carlo-based 90% CL limits for hypothetical experiments at resonance frequencies of 0.1 Hz, 1 Hz, and 10 Hz. These are sensitivity forecasts for future experimental capabilities, not measured exclusions from actual data. The framework is applied to a generic sensor model with details in Figure 5. Mass range discussed: 5×10^-20 eV to 5×10^-15 eV. No new measured limit is reported.
